onChange.template: [Category: movement] Apply the Dynamic art style to the Movement module. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Smooth art style to the Movement module. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Precise art style to the Movement module. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/category.schema.json, set mc_movement_style to {{mc_movement_style}}]
Set all character movement to {{mc_movement_style}} mode (useForceAsInputs in MovementAbility).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/category.schema.json, set mc_strafe_mode to {{mc_strafe_mode}}]
Set character facing mode to {{mc_strafe_mode}} (strafeMode in MovementAbility).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/category.schema.json, set mc_acceleration to {{mc_acceleration}}]
Set acceleration mode to {{mc_acceleration}} (enableAcceleration in MovementAbility).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/category.schema.json, set mt_move_speed to {{mt_move_speed}}]
Set moveSpeed to {{mt_move_speed}} in MovementAbility. Current: accel_time={{mt_accel_time}}, rotation_speed={{mt_rotation_speed}}

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/category.schema.json, set mt_accel_time to {{mt_accel_time}}]
Set accelerationTime to {{mt_accel_time}} seconds in MovementAbility. Current: move_speed={{mt_move_speed}}

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/category.schema.json, set mt_decel_factor to {{mt_decel_factor}}]
Set decelerationFactor to {{mt_decel_factor}} in MovementAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/category.schema.json, set mt_rotation_speed to {{mt_rotation_speed}}]
Set rotationSpeed to {{mt_rotation_speed}} in MovementAbility.
